assay_run.method: Study-level aggregate comparing TGF-β1 alone with TGF-β1 plus 7-OCT. Three independent replicates per condition. Acetone precipitation and tryptic digestion; data-dependent acquisition (TopN15); Proteome Discoverer 2.4 with a UniProt Homo sapiens database. Individual preparation/acquisition identities and sample-to-file mapping are unresolved in the supplied materials.
